exposure_boundary.inspected_before_binding: Exact workbook text headers and replicate-label metadata only. Numeric first-row cells redacted. Archive ZIP metadata/CRC/full hashes and unchanged earlier-workbook byte identity were checked.

source_semantics.ESS_definition: Article Par57: per-cell z-score of activity, subtract each element mean across three cells. This labels a different endpoint; arithmetic agreement and exact convention remain unverified until the frozen audit.
source_semantics.activity_unit: Source log2(RNA/DNA), library/cell/assay-relative; not absolute transcription or endogenous effect.
source_semantics.article_normalization: Article Methods describe per-replicate median activity normalization followed by averaging three replicates to combine observations. Header roles establish measurands, not exact implementation history.
source_semantics.compact_export_exclusions: Count, ratio, barcode and type/category columns remain in the byte-exact raw source but are not part of this compact activity/ESS export. No additional filtering performed. HepG2 replicate sheet has unbound numeric first-row cells H:K, redacted and not interpreted.
source_semantics.experimental_unit: Three infections within one common library/source study, not independent studies.
source_semantics.primary_aggregate_choice: The explicitly labeled all-cell summary activity table is the prespecified published aggregate route. Per-cell summary mean columns are retained separately, not selected by numerical agreement.
source_semantics.primary_replicate_choice: Use explicitly named replicate_level log2(rna/dna) observed fields for the primary three-replicate routes. Per-cell summary replicate columns remain distinct; no rounding/precision or agreement-based substitution.
source_semantics.replicate_normalization_status: Whether replicate_level values already have the article median centering is not asserted from headers; the frozen arithmetic routes examine provided and explicitly centered values.
source_semantics.source_role: Original published joint-library observed log2(RNA/DNA) activity/replicates and a separately labeled published ESS table. No prediction fields selected.

target_processing: Published library-normalized log2(RNA/DNA) aggregate values unchanged; source normalization and QC precede grouped splitting; no ESS outcome or response fit reused.
